name: Beijing
subject: the round Temple of Heaven hall on its marble terraces
composition: the hall centred above the stepped terraces
placement: curved around the circle between two concentric border lines, like a classic round passport stamp (top arc, and the bottom arc if there is a second line)

name: Shanghai
subject: the Oriental Pearl Tower and the Bund across the Huangpu River
composition: the river across the middle, the tower on the far bank
placement: in a solid straight header bar across the top, the letters reversed out (paper colour) inside the inked bar

name: Chengdu
subject: a giant panda eating bamboo
composition: the panda close up, bamboo framing the sides
placement: curved along the inside of the arch top, following its curve

name: Chongqing
subject: the stilted buildings of Hongyadong stacked on a cliff over the river
composition: buildings stacked up the frame, the river at the bottom
placement: in one ribbon banner across the top edge; no other ribbons or banners

name: Xi'an
subject: rows of Terracotta Warriors
composition: warriors in rows receding in perspective, one large in front
placement: as very large bold block letters across the middle like a vintage 'greetings from' postcard, the scene visible behind and inside the letters (any second line small underneath)

name: Guilin
subject: karst peaks along the Li River with a cormorant fisherman on a bamboo raft
composition: the raft in front, peaks layered behind
placement: set vertically down the left edge, one upright letter under another, inside a narrow vertical strip of the border

name: China
subject: the Great Wall of China with watchtowers over mountain ridges
composition: the wall zig-zagging diagonally across the frame
placement: curved along the inside of the dome's round top; the flat bottom edge has no lettering

name: China
subject: a dragon dance under hanging red lanterns
shape: square with a perforated postage-stamp edge
composition: the dragon's body curving through the frame, lanterns at the top
placement: in a solid straight header bar across the bottom, the letters reversed out (paper colour) inside the inked bar

name: Istanbul
subject: the domes and minarets of the Blue Mosque with a ferry and seagulls on the Bosphorus
composition: the ferry and gulls in the foreground, the mosque skyline across the back
placement: curved around the circle between two concentric border lines, like a classic round passport stamp (top arc, and the bottom arc if there is a second line)

name: Cappadocia
subject: hot-air balloons over the fairy chimney rock formations of Cappadocia
composition: balloons of different sizes filling the sky, the fairy chimneys along the bottom
placement: on a BIG luggage tag, about one third of the stamp's width and clearly a major element of the design, hanging from the lower right corner of the border by a short loop of string and overlapping the corner, with the lettering in large bold capitals that fill the tag

name: Turkey
subject: Turkish tea in a tulip-shaped glass with an evil-eye charm and hanging mosaic lamps
composition: the tea glass large in front, lamps hanging from the top, the charm at the side
placement: curved along the inside of the arch top, following its curve

name: Turkey
subject: the white travertine terraces and turquoise pools of Pamukkale
composition: the stepped terraces cascading down the frame, a few tiny figures for scale
placement: in one ribbon banner across the top edge; no other ribbons or banners
